name: Proper Ordered Sample Compression / co-VC Dimension (affine)
proof_source: Proposition \ref{prop:proper-compression-covc} in the LaTeX survey. The proof uses deletion samples of a projected hollow star and actual proper reconstructions.
details: For every nonempty finite binary class, $\mathrm{pOSC}\ge\mathrm{coVC}-1$. This bound requires proper reconstruction; it is not a bound on ordinary OSC.
witness_verification: On the full cube $2^{[n]}$, the established endpoint values are $n$ and $0$. The first grows unboundedly while co-VC is zero, excluding every reverse affine bound. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
